title: Broadcast Pixelmon
description: BroadcastPixelmon is a server-side Pixelmon sidemod that broadcasts global chat messages when Legendaries, Shinies, Bosses, Ultra Beasts, and Raid Legendaries spawn, including coordinates, biome, and clickable JourneyMap waypoints.
body:
BroadcastPixelmon is a server-side Pixelmon sidemod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge) that automatically broadcasts global chat messages when special Pokémon spawn in the world.

Features:

📢 Announces Legendary Pokémon spawns with coordinates and biome
⭐ Announces Shiny Pokémon spawns
💀 Announces Boss Pokémon spawns with tier and tier color
⚔️ Announces Legendary Raid starts
🌀 Announces Ultra Beast spawns
All messages include the nearest player, biome, and clickable coordinates that create a JourneyMap waypoint automatically
Server-side only — no client installation required
Dependencies:

Pixelmon 9.3.14
JourneyMap (optional, for waypoint creation)
 

If you have any ideas for improvement, please share them in the comments.
